README.md.text:
# t3code

A demo workspace for reference captures.

## Retry

The sync engine retries with `retryDelay`, capped at **five seconds**.

| Attempt | Delay |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 200 ms |
| 5 | 3200 ms |

workspace.patch:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 053464b..6c0035c 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
 # t3code
 
 A demo workspace for reference captures.
+
+## Retry
+
+The sync engine retries with `retryDelay`, capped at **five seconds**.
+
+| Attempt | Delay |
+| --- | --- |
+| 1 | 200 ms |
+| 5 | 3200 ms |
diff --git a/src/math.ts b/src/math.ts
index 508f35f..446ae29 100644
--- a/src/math.ts
+++ b/src/math.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,7 @@
 export function sum(a: number, b: number) {
   return a + b;
 }
+
+export function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
+  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
+}
diff --git a/logo.png b/logo.png
new file mode 100644
Binary files /dev/null and b/logo.png differ
diff --git a/src/retry.ts b/src/retry.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/retry.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+import { clamp } from "./math";
+
+/** Retry delay with jitter, capped at five seconds. */
+export function retryDelay(attempt: number) {
+  return clamp(2 ** attempt * 100, 100, 5000);
+}
